name: Sojourner Rover
description: Explore the story of Sojourner, the first successful Mars rover, which explored the surface of Ares Vallis and studied Martian rocks and soil.
spacecraft: Six-wheeled microrover carried to the surface by the Pathfinder lander.
objectives: Demonstrate a low-cost way to reach Mars and operate a small rover.
tagline: The first rover to drive on Mars, in 1997.

name: Opportunity Rover
description: The rover that outlasted its planned 90-day mission by nearly 15 years.
spacecraft: Solar-powered rover, twin of the Spirit rover.
objectives: Search for evidence of past water on Mars.
tagline: Planned for 90 days, it lasted nearly 15 years.

name: Spirit Rover
description: The rover that searched Gusev Crater for signs of past water and kept exploring for years beyond its planned mission.
spacecraft: Solar-powered rover, twin of the Opportunity rover.
objectives: Search for evidence of past water on Mars.
Study the geology of Gusev Crater.
tagline: Explored Gusev Crater far beyond its 90-day plan.

name: InSight Lander
description: The lander that listened for marsquakes to reveal what the inside of Mars is like.
spacecraft: Stationary lander carrying a seismometer, a heat probe and a radio science experiment.
objectives: Study the deep interior of Mars.
Measure marsquakes and the planet's heat flow.
tagline: Listened for marsquakes to study Mars' interior.

name: Lunar Roving Vehicle
description: The electric rover that let astronauts travel far beyond their landing sites on the Moon.
spacecraft: Folding, battery-powered two-seat rover carried to the Moon on the Lunar Module.
objectives: Carry astronauts and equipment across the lunar surface.
Extend the range of surface exploration.
tagline: Carried Apollo astronauts far beyond their landing sites.

name: Solar Wind Spectrometer
description: The instrument that measured the particles of the solar wind reaching the Moon.
spacecraft: Part of the Apollo Lunar Surface Experiments Package set up by astronauts.
objectives: Measure the energy and flow of the solar wind at the lunar surface.
tagline: Measured the solar wind reaching the Moon.

name: Surveyor 1
description: NASA's first soft landing on the Moon, sending back thousands of images of the lunar surface.
spacecraft: Uncrewed lander with a television camera and surface-sampling instruments.
objectives: Demonstrate a soft landing on the Moon.
Photograph the lunar surface in preparation for Apollo.
tagline: NASA's first soft landing on the Moon.

name: Ranger 7
description: The first U.S. spacecraft to send back close-up images of the Moon before it crashed into the surface.
spacecraft: Uncrewed spacecraft with six television cameras that sent pictures until it impacted the Moon.
objectives: Take close-up pictures of the lunar surface before impact.
Help scout landing sites for later Apollo missions.
tagline: First U.S. close-up pictures of the Moon.
